endpoints.truth_yaml:
put:
  operationId: updateHoliday
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  summary: Update a holiday by ID (partial update)
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
    - name: holidayId
      in: path
      required: true
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            name:
              type: string
            datePeriod:
              type: object
            occursAnnually:
              type: boolean
            everyoneIncludingNew:
              type: boolean
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Updated holiday object
endpoints.notes: PUT returns 200 with updated holiday. Tool: clockify_holidays_update. Partial update confirmed: unspecified fields merge from existing. IMPORTANT: automaticTimeEntryCreation field cannot be sent as a boolean in PUT body (400 JSON parse error — Clockify expects an object type). MCP tool correctly omits this field. Probe used real holiday ID <redacted-id:1f2fabbad9> with same-value no-op update.

  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  summary: Update workspace-level hourly rate
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
  requestBody:
    required: true
    content:
      application/json:
        schema:
          type: object
          properties:
            amount:
              type: integer
              description: Rate in minor currency units
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Full workspace object with updated hourlyRate
endpoints.notes: No dedicated MCP tool for workspace hourly rate. GET probe returned 405 confirming path is registered. PUT {amount:0} returned 200 with full workspace object. The workspace hourly rate was already 0 — no actual change made. Body structure: {amount: <minor_units>}. Response includes full workspace memberships with individual user rates.

discrepancies.live_value: 405 - Request method PUT is not supported
discrepancies.description: Spec documents PUT /workspaces/{wId}/member-profile/{userId} but live server returns 405 for PUT. The path itself is live (GET returns 200 with member profile data). The correct mutation verb appears to be PATCH based on prior batch evidence (20260521-233258-patch.workspaces.member-profile-path-probe.json was probed in a prior batch). This is an ours-only endpoint.

endpoints.truth_yaml:
put:
  operationId: updateMemberProfile
  x-verification-status: LIVE-OVERRIDE
  x-live-override-reason: PUT returns 405; path is live but only GET and likely PATCH are supported
  summary: Update member profile (OURS-ONLY — PUT not accepted live)
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
    - name: userId
      in: path
      required: true
endpoints.notes: LIVE-OVERRIDE. GET /member-profile/{userId} returns 200 with full profile (name, email, weekStart, workCapacity, workingDays, userCustomFieldValues). PUT returns 405 'Request method PUT is not supported'. The path is registered and live but PUT is not the correct method. Prior batch evidence shows PATCH is supported on /member-profile. Ours-only endpoint — may have been changed from PUT to PATCH at some point.
